Iris: Quick report from growth QA: sample-payments app doubled callbacks when a long /complete-payment hit 429 while our auth tokens rotated. Repro is noisy but consistent under concurrency.

Dan: Can you paste request headers + server 429? curious whether Retry-After or other rate headers were present.

Iris: Server responded with Retry-After: 0.4. Client retry logic rounded to 0 and retried immediately. No idempotency header in quickstart. Logs: 
```
[3123456789] req=start id=op-77
[3123456791] resp=429 Retry-After: 0.4
[3123456791] client retry delay=0ms attempt=1
[3123456792] token rotate old=tok1 new=tok2
[3123456794] webhook posted id=op-77
[3123456794] webhook posted id=op-77 (duplicate)
```

Kim: Two things: SDKs must parse Retry-After as float and clamp (min 100ms). Also quickstart should generate X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key per logical op for HTTP flows.

Dan: Agree. Also propose an opt-in resume shim for streaming/long-running ops: client adds X-Redwood-Resume-Shim: nonce at start; server can return X-Redwood-Resume-Token when it has partial progress. Retries with resume-token will continue instead of full replay. That'll cut duplicates for side-effecting streams.

Iris: Nice. Can you sketch the contract? We need server + SDK wiring + docs.

Dan: Contract sketch:
- Client: on first request send X-Redwood-Resume-Shim: <UUID> and X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key: <UUID>.
- Server: if request accepted, respond 202 + X-Redwood-Resume-Token: <cursor> and include Idempotency echo header.
- On 429 or retry, client will wait max(Retry-After*1000, backoff(attempt)) and then retry including Resume-Token if present. Server will resume from cursor and avoid re-triggering side-effects.

Kim: For backoff, prefer full jitter. Example (JS):
```js
function backoff(attempt, base=150){
  const cap = 20000;
  const raw = Math.min(cap, base * Math.pow(2, attempt));
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * raw);
}
// if Retry-After present: delay = Math.max(Math.round(parsedRetryAfter*1000), backoff(attempt))
```

Iris: Also note proxy retries (kong/nginx) were adding blind retries. We should add infra rule: do not auto-retry 4xx on /v1/* paths and forward idempotency headers upstream. Filed INF-1203.

DevX Bot: Docs stub: https://redwood.dev/docs/sdk/retries (added draft section "resume shim + idempotency"). Issue RD-11022 created for SDK parity (parse fractional Retry-After, idempotency, resume-shim).

Dan: Action items: 1) Node/Go/Python SDKs: parse Retry-After floats, clamp min 100ms, implement full-jitter backoff, auto-add Idempotency header for HTTP flows (config opt-out). 2) Backend: implement resume-token support on generate/complete endpoints. 3) Infra: disable proxy blind retries for generate endpoints + forward headers. 4) Docs/quickstart: update examples to include idempotency + resume shim. 5) QA: add integration sim with token rotate + proxy retry to assert duplicates < 0.1%.

Iris: I'll take quickstart updates + QA harness. Kim take Go/Python parity. Dan take Node SDK patch.
